owners.notes: Registered physical Infrastructure instance; immutable internal identity with exactly one Site.
Infrastructure may create/correct the resolution relation; operational relationships continue to point to Device Reference.
Physical placement chain; row/column/position remain placement semantics, not identity.
One-parent acyclic Network Element forest independent from placement.
Descriptive addressing only; no topology/reachability authority.
Reusable compatibility/reference knowledge separate from installed instances.
Per-Network-Element physical component identity/history, including slot/serial/chronology where known.
Workbook is untrusted evidence; accepted HLD-09 command owns domain mutation.

derived_context: Network Element Customer context derives through its authoritative Site and owning Customer Organization relationships rather than copied mutable labels.
Rack Site derives through Rack -> Room -> Site.
Cloud Type for a Network Element derives through its accepted Cloud Deployment.
Operational ticket/Inventory views may display Network Element data through Device Reference resolution without changing ownership.
prohibitions: Infrastructure does not infer RFC Customer ownership.
Infrastructure does not establish connectivity from containment, placement, Cloud or IP data.
Infrastructure does not store reusable device passwords, keys or SSH secrets.
Infrastructure does not mutate terminal ticket history when Device Reference resolution is corrected later.
